title: Writing --- Four Lines About You
label: ch:escribir-ficha-personal
canDo: I can fill a personal-information form with my name, age, origin and address, using only frames I already hold.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-W01-ficha-personal: write four frames about yourself in the order a form asks for them, and stop when the four facts are down.
payoff.note: Introduces nothing, so the HL05 representativeness rule is skipped by its own zero-guard; every atom assessed here is taught far earlier.
